_week: 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-24 (Week 43). Written from that week's numbers; rewrite every key each Monday.
week_story: The drop is mostly Octaspring Queen: it sold 17 units vs 79 the week before (-78%) because it has 0 units available at FBA, with 400 inbound.
refunds: Refunds land against orders from earlier weeks, so part of this is the Prime Big Deal Days volume coming back. Worth checking the return reasons for the Queen and King toppers.
pacing_reco: Getting the Queen topper back in stock is the biggest lever: it is the top-selling line and has been unavailable since the Prime event.
ads_context: The Prime Big Deal Days week (Oct 4–10) ran at 14.7% ACoS and 6.5% TACoS.
Since then traffic cooled and the Queen topper went out of stock, so ACoS rose to the low-to-mid 20s.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned 6.0x at 16.7% ACoS and brought 64 of 88 orders.
Category keywords cost $1,785 for $4,499 in sales (39.7% ACoS); spend there was cut 45% vs last week.
bid_moves: Lower the bid on “mattress +topper” (phrase): $1,191 spent for 4 orders.
Pause or negate the two Sponsored Brands “dormeo” phrase targets with clicks and no sales ($260).
category_readout: Non-branded searches are the expensive side of the account: category keywords ran at 39.7% ACoS this week vs 16.7% for branded.
The generic “mattress +topper” phrase target alone spent $1,191 for 4 orders (73.6% ACoS).
The searches that did convert are size-specific (“bed toppers queen size”, “split king”, “short king”). Move budget toward size-specific exact keywords and away from the broad generic phrase.
coupons: October to date: 127 coupon redemptions, mostly during Prime Big Deal Days.
promotions: This week: 11 promotion orders, $332 in promotional discounts (vs $1,656 last week).
Discounting has stepped down since the Prime event, which helps margin but removes a conversion lever while the Queen is out of stock.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: have the Queen and King toppers in stock at FBA before Nov 20 so BF/CM traffic converts.
inventory_readout: Octaspring Queen: 0 available, 400 inbound, ~100 sold per week. Its 30-day sales were $152,600, so every week out costs real revenue.
Octaspring King is next: about 1.6 weeks available at FBA with 227 inbound.
Premium Cal King is down to 1 unit.
reviews_body: Sellerise returned no review records, rating trend or negative reviews for the 33 Dormeo US products over the last 90 days.
That means the review tracker isn't pulling for this account, not that there were no reviews.
reviews_reco: Turn on review tracking for Dormeo US in Sellerise (or pull Amazon's Customer Reviews report) so next week's deck shows star rating and review count per line.
With the refund rate at 23.0% this week, reading the newest 1–3 star reviews for the Queen and King toppers is the quickest way to see whether the returns share a cause.
alerts_readout: Most alerts are routine listing changes (images, price, title).
Buy Box: lost 10 times and regained 10 times. The latest Buy Box alert (Oct 26) is on the Premium Queen topper, the out-of-stock ASIN.
11 inactive and 5 out-of-stock alerts line up with the inventory gaps on the previous slide.
recommendations: Get the 400 inbound Queen toppers checked in at FBA; confirm the ETA and follow up on any receiving delay.
Send King (1.6 wk) and Cal King (1 unit) replenishment so neither stocks out before BF/CM.
Lower bids on the generic “mattress +topper” phrase target and the “dormeo” phrase targets running above 35% ACoS.
Add the 3 converting searches as exact keywords; negate the 19 no-sale search terms after review.
While Queen is out of stock, shift Queen-campaign budget to King and Full, which are in stock and grew this week.
Plan BF/CM coupons and deals for the toppers (Nov 27–30) and confirm submission deadlines.
Turn on review tracking and review return reasons behind the 23% refund rate.
position: October is +51% ahead of last year to date and pacing to about $437.2K.
This week slowed to $62.7K because the Queen topper, the top seller, was out of stock all week.
next_steps: Restock Queen at FBA; protect King and Cal King.
Trim spend on generic and no-sale targets.

Review tracking turned on in Sellerise.
